## `/fundadmin:fund portfolio-dashboard <files>` {#portfolio-dashboard}

Multi-fund aggregation from supplied statements

Aggregates several funds' supplied statements into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, and unfunded commitments. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund portfolio-dashboard`, asks how the book is doing, or shares capital accounts across funds.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund portfolio-dashboard <files>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-portfolio-dashboard <files>` |
| Codex | `$fund-portfolio-dashboard <files>` |

**Writes** `PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-portfolio-dashboard/SKILL.md)

Uses the host's approved file access and the packaged helpers where required.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund reconcile <file1> <file2>` {#reconcile}

Cross-document reconciliation & discrepancy detection

Matches two fund documents line by line (capital call vs capital account, distribution vs K-1, sequential statements, PCAPs vs financial statements) and lists every break with helper workpapers. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund reconcile` or asks why balances do not tie.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund reconcile <file1> <file2>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-reconcile <file1> <file2>` |
| Codex | `$fund-reconcile <file1> <file2>` |

**Writes** `RECONCILIATION-[fund]-[type]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-reconcile/SKILL.md)

**Dependencies and fallbacks**

- **openpyxl** — the .xlsx of the report's tables. If unavailable: CSV of the same tables.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund review-deed <file>` {#review-deed}

Deed of adherence / equity wrapper review

Reviews a deed of adherence, equity wrapper, or management participation agreement: obligations assumed, vesting, good and bad leaver terms, and information access limits. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund review-deed`, asks to check leaver terms, or shares a deed.
